ideas: "The Coffee‑Crash Loop": Show a coffee cup morphing into a brain wave, narrate how caffeine hijacks the reward system (source: early 20th‑century psych texts).
"The Smartphone‑Pull Effect": Use a magnetic animation to illustrate how notifications exploit intermittent reinforcement (cite Skinner’s operant conditioning).
"The Mirror‑Self Bias": Split‑screen of a person looking in a mirror vs. a crowd, explain the self‑reference effect with a classic experiment excerpt.
avoid: Overused "dark psychology" clickbait phrases that have become saturated
